name: vwap_slope_trend_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional TWAP and VWAP execution algorithms are benchmarked against session VWAP — when they need to buy, they systematically lift offers at progressively higher prices, causing the VWAP slope to rise. At 5-second resolution, the 3-minute VWAP slope (linreg over 36 bars) captures this institutional directional pressure before it fully manifests in price. When the 1-minute slope (12 bars) exceeds the 3-minute slope, it signals that institutional demand is accelerating, not plateauing — the executing TWAP order has not finished and the remaining flow will push NIFTY spot another 10-20 points in the same direction. This acceleration window is the entry trigger: buy CE when slope is positive and building, buy PE when slope is negative and deepening, holding for the next 60-90 seconds while institutional execution continues.
core_signal_oneliner: 3-minute VWAP slope positive and building (slope_12 > slope_36) with price above VWAP and above 3-minute EMA, signaling institutional TWAP acceleration
